zh: 每个回文子串都由它的中心和半径唯一确定；中心可以落在某个字符上（奇数长度），也可以落在两个相邻字符之间（偶数长度）。
长度只有 1000，可以枚举全部 2n-1 个中心，从中心向两侧同步扩展；只要两端字符相等，就又得到一个新的回文子串。
对 center 从 0 到 2n-2，令 left=center/2、right=(center+1)/2；当 left≥0、right<n 且 s[left]==s[right] 时，答案加一，left 减一、right 加一；全部中心处理完输出答案。
en: Every palindromic substring is uniquely determined by its center and radius; the center can be on a character (odd length) or between two adjacent characters (even length).
With length only up to 1000, enumerate all 2n-1 centers and expand outward from each; every time both ends match you have found one more palindromic substring.

For center from 0 to 2n-2, set left = center/2 and right = (center+1)/2; while left >= 0, right < n and s[left] == s[right], add one to the answer and move left down and right up; print the answer after all centers.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Enumerate odd and even centers and expand to both sides until the characters differ; each successful expansion counts one palindrome.

## Correctness

Every palindrome corresponds uniquely to its center and radius. Expanding from a center visits exactly all valid radii for that center, and different centers or radii give different index ranges, so nothing is missed or counted twice.

## Complexity

Time O(n^2), auxiliary space O(1).
